name: TEXTJOIN
description: TEXTJOIN joins text from multiple ranges or strings using a delimiter you specify, with an option to ignore empty cells.
tldr: Joins text with a delimiter, optionally skipping blanks.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: A text string inserted between each item, e.g. ", " or "-". Can be empty.

parameters.name: ignore_empty
parameters.description: TRUE to skip empty cells/strings; FALSE to include them as gaps.

parameters.name: text1
parameters.description: The first text item, range, or array to join.

parameters.name: text2
parameters.description: Additional text items, ranges, or arrays to join (optional).

basicExample.description: Join a short list with a comma
basicExample.explanation: The trailing empty string is ignored because ignore_empty is TRUE, so no extra comma appears.

advancedExamples.title: Join a whole range
advancedExamples.scenario: Cells A1:A5 contain names with some blanks
advancedExamples.result: Names joined by a pipe, blanks skipped
advancedExamples.explanation: A range is accepted directly and empty cells are omitted.

advancedExamples.title: Build a multi-line address
advancedExamples.scenario: Join street, city, and zip from separate cells
advancedExamples.description: Use a line break as delimiter
advancedExamples.result: Street City Zip on separate lines
advancedExamples.explanation: CHAR(10) is a line break; with wrap-text enabled this renders as multiple lines.

howItWorks: TEXTJOIN iterates through each supplied text value or cell in the ranges, places the delimiter between consecutive non-skipped items, and (when ignore_empty is TRUE) drops empty strings so no stray delimiters appear.

howToSteps.name: Pick a delimiter
howToSteps.text: Choose the separator, e.g. ", " or CHAR(10).

howToSteps.name: Decide on empties
howToSteps.text: Set ignore_empty to TRUE to skip blanks.

howToSteps.name: Supply the texts
howToSteps.text: List ranges or strings, then press Enter.

limitations: Not available in Excel 2013 and earlier; use CONCATENATE or a helper column there.
Total result is capped at 32,767 characters; exceeding it returns #VALUE!.
Delimiter is added between items only, never before the first or after the last.

commonErrors.cause: Using TEXTJOIN in an Excel version older than 2016.
commonErrors.fix: Upgrade, use the free Microsoft add-in, or fall back to CONCATENATE with a helper column.
Reduce the number or length of joined items.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: TEXTJOIN is fully supported in Google Sheets with the same arguments.

faq.question: Which Excel versions have TEXTJOIN?
faq.answer: Excel 2016 and later, plus Microsoft 365; it is unavailable in Excel 2013 and earlier.

faq.question: How do I skip blank cells?
faq.answer: Set the second argument, ignore_empty, to TRUE.

faq.question: Can the delimiter be empty?
faq.answer: Yes, use "" as the delimiter to concatenate without separators.
